eyebrow: Sequential: one gate, then the next
code:
Approval #1 (Manager)
  -> If/Else on outcome
     approved -> Approval #2 (Finance)
     rejected -> rejection path

caption: A later stage never starts until the stage before it is approved.

code:
Any:  first response wins
      (approve OR reject ends the stage)

All:  waits for every named approver
      (one rejection usually ends it rejected)
caption: A setting on the Approval action itself, not a separate build step.

steps.label: Approval action runs
steps.sub: produces an outcome: approved or rejected

steps.label: Outcome exposed as a data pill
steps.sub: the same mechanism as any other action's output

steps.label: If/Else branches on it
steps.sub: approved continues forward, rejected routes to its own path

code:
High-cost equipment request:
  Approval (Manager) -> approved?
    yes -> Approval (Finance, "all")
    no  -> rejection path
  Finance approved? -> fulfillment
  Finance rejected? -> rejection path
caption: Sequential stages because Finance shouldn't review what Manager already rejected.
